criteria.text: The participant has histologically or cytologically documented non-squamous NSCLC.

source.text: Histologically or cytologically documented non-squamous NSCLC.

criteria.text: The participant has Stage III B/C or IV NSCLC (based on the American Joint Committee on Cancer Edition 8) not amenable to curative treatment.

source.text: Stage III B/C or IV NSCLC (based on the American Joint Committee on Cancer Edition 8) not amenable to curative treatment.

criteria.text: The participant does not have sensitizing EGFR mutations (including, but not limited to, exon 19 deletion and exon 21 L858R, exon 21 L861Q, exon 18 G719X, and exon 20 S768I mutations) and ALK and ROS1 rearrangements.

source.text: Absence of sensitizing EGFR mutations (including, but not limited to, exon 19 deletion and exon 21 L858R, exon 21 L861Q, exon 18 G719X, and exon 20 S768I mutations) and ALK and ROS1 rearrangements.

criteria.text: The participant does not have documented tumor genomic mutation results from tests conducted as part of standard local practice in any other actionable driver oncogenes for which there are locally approved and available targeted 1L therapies.

source.text: Absence of documented tumor genomic mutation results from tests conducted as part of standard local practice in any other actionable driver oncogenes for which there are locally approved and available targeted 1L therapies.

criteria.text: The participant provides an acceptable tumor sample to confirm tumor PD-L1 expression TC ≥ 1%.

source.text: Provision of acceptable tumor sample, to confirm tumor PD-L1 expression TC ≥ 1%.

criteria.text: The participant has at least one lesion not previously irradiated that qualifies as a RECIST 1.1 TL at baseline and can be accurately measured at baseline as ≥ 10 mm in the longest diameter (except lymph nodes, which must have short axis ≥ 15 mm) with CT or MRI and is suitable for accurate repeated measurements.

source.text: At least one lesion not previously irradiated that qualifies as a RECIST 1.1 TL at baseline and can be accurately measured at baseline as ≥ 10 mm in the longest diameter (except lymph nodes, which must have short axis ≥ 15 mm) with CT or MRI and is suitable for accurate repeated measurements.

criteria.text: The participant has adequate organ and bone marrow function.

source.text: Adequate organ and bone marrow function

criteria.text: The participant has small cell and neuroendocrine histology components.

source.text: Presence of small cell and neuroendocrine histology components.

criteria.text: The participant has brain metastases unless asymptomatic, stable, and not requiring steroids or anticonvulsants for at least 7 days prior to randomization. A minimum of 2 weeks must have elapsed between the end of local therapy (brain radiotherapy or surgery) and randomization. Participants must have recovered from the acute toxic effect of radiotherapy (eg, dizziness and signs of increased intracranial pressure) or surgery prior to randomization.

source.text: Brain metastases unless asymptomatic, stable, and not requiring steroids or anticonvulsants for at least 7 days prior to randomization. A minimum of 2 weeks must have elapsed between the end of local therapy (brain radiotherapy or surgery) and randomization. Participants must have recovered from the acute toxic effect of radiotherapy (eg, dizziness and signs of increased intracranial pressure) or surgery prior to randomization.

criteria.text: The participant has any prior systemic therapy received for NSCLC except in the neoadjuvant or adjuvant setting or definitive chemoradiotherapy with the intent to cure, provided that progression has occurred > 12 months after the end of systemic therapy treatment.

source.text: Any prior systemic therapy received for NSCLC except in the neoadjuvant or adjuvant setting or definitive chemoradiotherapy with the intent to cure, provided that progression has occurred \> 12 months after the end of systemic therapy treatment.

criteria.text: The participant has any prior exposure to an anti-TIGIT therapy or any other anticancer therapy targeting immune-regulatory receptors or mechanisms.

source.text: Any prior exposure to an anti-TIGIT therapy or any other anticancer therapy targeting immune-regulatory receptors or mechanisms.

criteria.text: The participant has any prior treatment with an anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 agent.

source.text: Any prior treatment with an anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 agent.

criteria.text: The participant has a history of another primary malignancy except for malignancy treated with curative intent with no known active disease ≥ 2 years before the first dose of study intervention and of low potential risk for recurrence.

source.text: History of another primary malignancy except for malignancy treated with curative intent with no known active disease ≥ 2 years before the first dose of study intervention and of low potential risk for recurrence.

criteria.text: The participant has active or prior documented autoimmune or inflammatory disorders requiring chronic systemic treatment with the use of disease-modifying agents, corticosteroids, or immunosuppressive drugs.

source.text: Active or prior documented autoimmune or inflammatory disorders requiring chronic systemic treatment with the use of disease-modifying agents, corticosteroids, or immunosuppressive drugs.

criteria.text: The participant has active primary immunodeficiency/active infectious disease(s).
The participant has active tuberculosis infection.
